Subject: Starlite onboarding: provisional PO request and spend cap mismatch

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding checkpoint this week. We uploaded the onboarding form and the vendor packet yesterday but we still don't see a PO number assigned on our side. Our finance team is asking for a PO so they can schedule the pilot invoices.

A couple of specifics:
- Submitted line items show 3 SKUs: SLS-CORE (license), SLS-API (per-call), SLS-TRN (support).
- The onboarding portal shows a spend cap of $5,000 which is lower than the pilot budget we agreed on ($25,000).
- One of the line items (SLS-API) is missing the quantity column in the portal export; it looks like a CSV parsing/line-item mapping issue.

Can you issue a provisional PO or temporary reference we can route to our accounting team while you resolve the line-to-ledger mapping? If possible we need the PO this week to avoid delaying the kickoff.

I attached the onboarding answers we submitted. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Finance, Starlite Systems
[Attachment: starlite_onboarding_answers.pdf (PDF)]

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the form. I've looped in Priyom (procurement) and Monica (vendor ops) to get a provisional PO issued and to investigate the CSV mapping problem.

Two quick asks to speed things up:
1) Can you confirm Starlite's billing address and tax ID (TIN/EIN)? We'll need that to populate the PO.
2) For the SLS-API line, can you confirm target monthly calls for the pilot (ballpark is fine) so we can set a temporary per-line cap that matches your budget.

Priyom / Monica — can we stage a provisional PO (provisionally assign a reference like PO-2026-0571-P) with a pilot spend cap of $25k and mark SLS-API as pending quantity until Elena confirms? Also note Elena's comment about the portal export missing the quantity column — that needs a mapping fix so ledger codes line up with our internal SKU table.

Elena, once Priyom sends the provisional PO I'll follow up with estimated timelines for the permanent PO and final ledger remap.

-Jordan
